veranderings.blok: Die dag van die lang rye
veranderings.voor: Die stemmery het oor meer as een dag geloop en 27 April
veranderings.na: Die stemming het oor meer as een dag gestrek, en 27 April
veranderings.rede: 'Stemmery' and 'geloop' are colloquial; 'stemming ... gestrek' is standard, and the AWS comma is needed because both halves have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Die dag van die lang rye
veranderings.voor: van vroeg in die oggend ure lank
veranderings.na: van vroeg in die oggend af ure lank
veranderings.rede: The time expression 'van ... af' needs its closing 'af'.
Votes do not choose anything; the voters chose the Assembly, which keeps the meaning and matches the rest of the lesson.
AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: kon nie die ander partye met genoeg steun uit die regering hou nie
veranderings.na: kon nie die ander partye wat genoeg steun gehad het, uit die regering hou nie
veranderings.rede: 'met genoeg steun' can attach to 'uit die regering hou' (keep out by means of enough support); a relative clause ties it to the other parties and keeps the protected 'genoeg steun'.

veranderings.voor: Niemand kan later uitwerk watter stembrief joune was.
veranderings.na: Niemand kan later uitwerk watter stembrief joune was nie.
veranderings.rede: A sentence negated by 'niemand' needs the closing 'nie'; the protected wording stays intact and only 'nie' is added after it.

veranderings.blok: Dwang is moeilik maar nie onmoontlik nie
veranderings.voor: Die stemhokkie hou jou merk weg van die ander mense
veranderings.na: Die stemhokkie hou jou merk verborge vir die ander mense
veranderings.rede: 'Hou weg van' calques English 'keep away from'; 'verborge hou vir' is the Afrikaans idiom for hiding something from people.

veranderings.blok: Dwang is moeilik maar nie onmoontlik nie
veranderings.voor: sonder dat iemand ooit hoef na te gaan.
veranderings.na: sonder dat iemand ooit hoef na te gaan hoe jy gestem het.
veranderings.rede: 'Nagaan' is transitive and the sentence leaves its object out; repeating the previous sentence's 'hoe jy gestem het' makes the reference clear without adding content.

veranderings.voor: Wanneer geen party alleen genoeg steun het, moet
veranderings.na: Wanneer geen party alleen genoeg steun het nie, moet
veranderings.rede: A clause negated by 'geen' needs the closing 'nie' before the comma.

veranderings.voor: die President en hy kies dan
veranderings.na: die President, en hy kies dan
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: dieselfde partye hou of hulle kan
veranderings.na: dieselfde partye hou, of hulle kan
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'of' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: die mense self en dit is die hart
veranderings.na: die mense self, en dit is die hart
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
'Waar' refers to a place; an occasion takes 'waarby'.

veranderings.voor: Vandag in Suid-Afrika is dit 'n burger
veranderings.na: In Suid-Afrika is dit vandag 'n burger
veranderings.rede: Two stacked adverbials before the verb read stiffly; placing 'vandag' after the verb is the natural order.

vlae.teks: 'n Geleentheid waar mense stem om te kies wie hulle regeer.
vlae.rede: 'wie hulle regeer' can be read as 'whom they govern' as well as 'who governs them'; the meaning is clear from context, but the writer may want to check it reads one way only, alone.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Niemand kan later uitwerk watter stembrief joune was
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected wording lacks the closing negative 'nie' that standard Afrikaans needs after 'niemand'; the proposal adds 'nie' after it and leaves the protected words intact, but the protected entry itself may be better recorded with 'nie'.
